interpretations: For each region (`district.A3`), take the unweighted average of the raw `trans.amount` averages for accounts whose branch district is in that region. Return regions whose figure exceeds the unweighted average of all defined regional figures, with the region, its figure, the difference, and the ratio, without rounding.
queries:
WITH account_averages AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS account_average
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3
),
regional_figures AS (
    SELECT region, AVG(account_average) AS figure
    FROM account_averages
    GROUP BY region
)
SELECT
    region,
    figure,
    figure - (SELECT AVG(figure) FROM regional_figures) AS difference,
    figure / (SELECT AVG(figure) FROM regional_figures) AS ratio
FROM regional_figures
WHERE figure > (SELECT AVG(figure) FROM regional_figures)
